scripts.build: bun run docs:check && bun run typecheck && bunx --bun vite build
scripts.build:workers: bun run build && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js build --experimental-new-config --experimental-cf-build-output
scripts.build:workers:pre: bun run build:pre && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js build --experimental-new-config --experimental-cf-build-output --env pre
scripts.deploy:pre: bun run build:workers:pre && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode pre
scripts.deploy:check:pre: bun run build:workers:pre && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode pre --dry-run
scripts.test:browser: bun run build:pre && bunx --bun playwright test
scripts.build:pre: bun run docs:check && bun run typecheck && bunx --bun vite build --mode pre
